audio.speech: 一把旧扳手，装什么排面。少废话，合约就在这儿——签字，老宅地皮明天过户。

prompt: Close-up: an elderly man slams a contract dossier onto the table and presses his finger hard on the signature line, the paper sheet dominating half of the frame with soft illegible printed lines, static camera, dramatic side light. He is Father Lin, a Chinese patriarch in his sixties, combed-back silver-white hair, deep frown lines, stern hooded eyes, wearing an impeccable dark navy three-piece suit with a burgundy tie. The contract paper is aged ivory with a visible tooth and soft unreadable printed rules; his weathered hand, veins and a heavy gold signet ring, dents the page; the table is dark polished walnut mirroring a knife-edge of warm amber lamplight; dust motes hang in the raking side beam; deep shadow swallows the background. Cinematic photorealistic live-action Chinese short-drama look, natural detailed skin texture, filmic color grade of warm amber banquet glow against cool rain-blue night tones, soft volumetric practical lighting, 35mm anamorphic lens look, shallow depth of field, rich micro-contrast, graceful natural motion, vertical 9:16 portrait framing, no on-screen text, no watermark, no subtitles.
